pack.name: Edge Spectrum: Line Archive
pack.description: Forward capture of public ESPN lines into an append-only archive, for closing-line-value analysis, and a daily digest of how each line moved.

templates.name: Edge Spectrum: ESPN Line Capture
templates.description: Snapshots ESPN's public scoreboard for NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL and appends one JSON line per game (spread, total, moneyline, scores) to <output>/<SPORT>/<day>.jsonl, labelling each pre-game capture open, midday or close for closing-line-value analysis. Append-only, no keys. Needs Node 22 or 24 and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/.

parameters.label: edge-spectrum clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-spectrum, with `npm ci` run in its site/ folder.

parameters.label: Line archive folder
parameters.help: Where the JSONL files go. Files are only ever appended to.

parameters.label: Hours between runs
parameters.help: Match it to the schedule: a capture within this many hours of the start is labelled close.

templates.author: ai-automation-tools

templates.name: Edge Spectrum: Daily Line Movement Digest
templates.description: Reads yesterday's captures from the ESPN Line Capture archive and writes a markdown digest to <archive>/digests/<day>.md: each game's opening and closing spread, total and home moneyline, the final score, the biggest spread moves, and any game missing an opening or closing capture. Read-only over the archive, no keys, no network. Fails when the day has no capture file at all, which means the capture task did not run. Needs the line capture template running, Node 22 or 24 and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/.

parameters.label: edge-spectrum clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-spectrum, with `npm ci` run in its site/ folder.

parameters.label: Line archive folder
parameters.help: The ESPN Line Capture template's output folder. Digests go to its digests/ subfolder.

templates.author: ai-automation-tools
